decisions.reason: The Magento 2 template is cheap and close to the core, but it has not been seen on the website since 2018, and templates age quickly, so a quiet phase-out is quite possible even though there is no pressing shortfall.
The responsive template supports core CMS hosting at little cost, but it has only a weak web presence and may already have faded, so the drop risk is moderate while slack lets it stay.
Premium support embodies the firm's main differentiator of expert agency support and likely earns recurring revenue above aspiration, so there is no trigger for search.
The version management tool is integrated into the platform and cuts recurring work for agencies, in line with the firm's strategy, so keeping it is justified.
The data processing contract tool is distant from the core and GDPR novelty demand has passed, but its cost is low and it helps customers' compliance, so the growing firm's slack carries it.
Scalable agency hosting is the flagship and focus of the firm's direction in a growing market, so it clearly meets aspiration and will be kept.
